annotations.title: Irish market prices for a make and model

description: Use for an overview of one model in the Irish used market: listing count, price range, median, and median price and mileage by model year and by fuel type. Use price_check instead to value one specific car with year, mileage, fuel type and optional transmission. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

country.description: Market to query: IE = Ireland (default), GB = UK including Northern Ireland, ALL = both. Prices are always also given in EUR (GBP converted at the live ECB rate).
